capabilities: Replace new tabs with a customizable start page of cards and pages
Add and complete tasks in today's daily note with optional carry-forward
Create shortcuts to notes, folders, websites, and Obsidian commands
Search notes by name, alias, or path and capture text into the daily note
Show Unsplash or vault wallpapers and companion Qiaomu Reader, RSS, Radio, and Agent cards
extras: Mobile is not yet verified on real devices; desktop has been tested in real vaults. GPL-3.0-only with a separate commercial license option. Conflicts can occur if another plugin also owns the startup page. Community-submitted cards exist, and the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian opens to a file list or blank tab, with no single place to see today's tasks, jump to frequent notes, or resume reading and listening.

relations.evidence: Continue books, RSS articles, radio, and conversations through Qiaomu Reader, RSS, Radio, and Agent.
未读文章与数量，打开文章、添加订阅、搜索文章
最近电台、播放状态，直接播放或暂停
最近对话、新对话，从搜索框直接提问
启用 Tasks 插件时，勾选会写入完成日期并生成重复任务的下一次
识别 Tasks 的 📅 / ⏳ / 🛫 和 Dataview 的 [due:: ]
QuickAdd 动作、Dataview 查询、看板、Excalidraw 手绘
间隔复习和 Omnisearch 全文搜索

requires.name: Tasks, Dataview, QuickAdd, Excalidraw, Omnisearch, or companion Qiaomu plugins
GitHub token for the GitHub todo card

summary: Customizable start page that replaces new tabs with draggable cards for tasks, shortcuts, note search, daily capture, wallpapers, and optional media modules.
